changes: Update in one click: when a new version is out, press Update now, then Restart QuickCheck. No more downloading, unzipping or deleting the old copy.
Every update is checked before it is installed: it must be complete and signed by QuickCheck. Your classes, tests and scores are never touched.
Fixed: the update notice could not read the website's version file, so it never appeared.
Fixed: the Results list showed a line of computer text instead of each test's number of items.
A new look everywhere: a dashboard that shows what to do next, class and item charts, and the same clear layout on every page.
Points per item: on the answer key page, make some items worth more (for example items 1 to 5 worth 5 points each). Scores, the class record and reports use the points.
Answer sheets and Make a test are now numbered steps with a picture of the sheet, so you always know what to do next.
New tests print a compact answer sheet that ends just below the last question. Sheets you already printed for older tests still read as before.
Unreviewed papers stay in the review queue after a partial save. Adding photos cannot overwrite another paper after one is removed.
Safer saving: interrupted saves can be recovered, simultaneous phone uploads are kept, and invalid learner or score entries are explained.
Backups include Excel class records. Restore checks the backup first and keeps a safety copy of your current work.
Damaged results show a recovery message while other tests remain available. Phone links use the app's actual address.
